headline: Record demand drives a sharp beat and a raised outlook
summary_short: AAON reported record Q2 FY2026 net sales of $627.0 million, up 101.2% y/y, with diluted EPS of $0.68, up 257.9% y/y.
summary_long: Net sales rose 101.2% y/y to a record $627.0M on strong AAON and BASX demand and higher production throughput; BASX sales more than tripled. Gross margin fell to 24.3% from 26.6% as capacity-ramp costs and outsourcing offset volume gains. Operating income rose 192.1% on sales growth and SG&A leverage. Backlog reached $2.0B, up 98.0% y/y. Management raised FY2026 sales-growth guidance to 55%-60% (from 40%-45%) while lowering the gross-margin outlook to 25%-26% (from 27%-28%) on near-term capacity-ramp costs. Cash and restricted cash totaled $12.7M; revolver balance was $435.0M.
confidence_notes: The shard's total_cash_usd_m KPI ($0.013M) reflects only unrestricted cash and cash equivalents; the release separately discloses $12.7M of cash plus restricted cash combined. Non-GAAP adjusted diluted EPS ($0.69) differs slightly from GAAP diluted EPS ($0.68) due to a $1.4M Memphis facility incentive-fee add-back captured on extendedMetrics.

drivers.explanation: Growth reflected strong demand across both AAON and BASX brands, improved manufacturing throughput, and increased utilization of recently added production capacity.
Margin compression reflected ramping costs from recently added capacity (including the Memphis facility), greater use of outsourced components, and inflationary cost pressures.
Growth reflected strong net sales growth, improved overhead leverage, and disciplined SG&A management; SG&A fell 570bp as a percent of sales.
BASX-branded backlog rose 185.4% y/y on continued data-center investment activity; AAON-branded backlog rose 9.4% on strong order activity despite a soft commercial HVAC market.

Management cited higher throughput, strong backlog conversion, and continued execution, while flagging near-term margin pressure from the capacity ramp that pricing, sourcing, and productivity actions are addressing.
